earnings.title: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
highlights: Medtronic reported Q2 worldwide revenue of $9.364 billion, an increase of 4.5% as reported and 6.5% on an organic basis.
Scientia revenue of $26 million and SPR Therapeutics revenue of $28 million in the current year
Revenue from the Dutch Obesity Clinic (NOK) divestiture with no revenue in the current year and $5 million in the prior year
Foreign currency impact of -$16 million on the remaining net sales

Neuroscience Portfolio revenue of $2.705 billion increased 5.1% reported and 3.2% organic, with mid-single digit increase in Cranial & Spinal Technologies, low-single digit increase in Specialty Therapies, and low-single digit decrease in Neuromodulation, all on an organic basis

quotes.text: We delivered a strong second-quarter, with broad-based performance that reflects the strength of our business and our continued execution on our commitments.
quotes.by: Geoff Martha, chairman and chief executive officer

quotes.text: Our priority is to continue converting the momentum in our businesses into strong financial performance.

outlook: Revenue of $9.4 billion, increased 4.5% as reported and 6.5% organic, roughly 50 basis points above guidance midpoint
GAAP diluted EPS of $2.20; non-GAAP diluted EPS of $1.34, ahead of guidance midpoint by 1 cent
Reiterated FY27 organic revenue growth guidance of 7.25% to 7.75% and diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance of $5.94 to $6.00, despite MiniMed separation
The company continues to expect FY27 organic revenue growth guidance of 7.25% to 7.75% and diluted non-GAAP EPS guidance of $5.94 to $6.00.

items.heading: We operate in a highly competitive industry and we may be unable to compete effectively.
Our success depends on our ability to differentiate our products and successfully execute and scale emerging technologies.
Reduction or interruption in supply or other manufacturing difficulties may adversely affect our manufacturing operations and related product sales.

Failure to identify, execute, and integrate acquired businesses into our operations successfully, or challenges related to the Company's strategic initiatives, including divestitures and third-party funding arrangements, as well as liabilities or claims relating to such acquired businesses, divestitures, or arrangements could adversely affect our business.

Public health crises have had, and may continue to have, an adverse effect on certain aspects of our business, results of operations, financial condition, and cash flows. The nature and extent of future impacts are highly uncertain and unpredictable.
We are subject to extensive and complex laws and governmental regulations and any adverse regulatory action may materially adversely affect our financial condition and business operations.
